The Spectrum License Purchase Agreement provides that the transfer of the Spectrum Licenses occurs in two steps: first, the transfer of the Spectrum Licenses by EchoStar to the Trust (the “Spectrum Transfer Closing”), and second, the Spectrum Licenses will be transferred by the Trust to the Company (the “Spectrum Acquisition Closing”).
